    The universal cover has no oriented cycles #

    CoverAcyclic x₀: no irreducible morphism a → b of the universal cover is followed by a path back from b to a. It holds for good covers (coverAcyclic_of_cycleFree), for covers with a positive cocycle (coverAcyclic_of_posCocycle), and passes from the residue P/μ to P (coverAcyclic_of_residue). Hence it holds for the ray category of a minimal representation-infinite distributive algebra with torsion-free fundamental group (coverIsAcyclic), by the case split of intervalFiniteCover_of_stage.
